description: This file contains unit tests for DynamoDB grain storage implementation in an Orleans-based application. It verifies storage serialization and deserialization of grain references, and includes test fixture setup for a test cluster with DynamoDB storage configurations.

classes.name: PersistenceGrainTests_AWSDynamoDBStore
classes.description: Unit test class for testing DynamoDB storage provider for Orleans grains, including serialization of grain references.

classes.description: Test fixture setting up a test Orleans cluster with DynamoDB storage configuration.

classes.name: PersistenceGrainTests_AWSDynamoDBStore.SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the test silo to use in-memory and DynamoDB grain storage providers.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test class, skips test if DynamoDB is unavailable.

methods.description: Test converting grain reference to storage format and back.

methods.description: Test converting lists and dictionaries of grain references to storage format and back.
